credential.note: reference existence and backing-file presence only; no credential value was read, emitted or decoded

read_only: engine version and image inspect only; no container created, no workload started, no Job submitted, no credential value read, nothing written anywhere
what_a_denial_means: Per reroute340145 a denial is reported and the turn STOPS. No escalation, no workaround, no alternative engine, no image build, no credential substitution.
what_a_structural_check_cannot_do: it cannot establish that a provider session is valid. run341637 failed on an expired OAuth session 0.337s after a clean check of this kind.
when: BEFORE STAGING, as reroute347178 and the accepted PLAN require
why_not_the_boundary_preflight: the boundary preflight reads packet/AUTHORING-COMMAND.json, which only exists after bind. This is the earlier check, against the packet pins; the boundary preflight still runs after bind and is the stronger one.
